beats.say: This entire video was recorded and edited by an agent. Nobody touched a timeline, and nobody touched a mouse.
It runs in a headless browser, so there is no screen to take over and nothing personal ever ends up in frame.
The pointer you can see is drawn by Rendr from a path the script authored, rather than captured from hardware.
Because the script knows where it clicked, every punch in lands on the thing that was clicked.
The zooms, the cursor, the voice and the subtitles are all generated from one storyboard file.
This narration is Kokoro, running locally on the machine. No API key, and nothing leaves the laptop.
